title: Some Memories Must Fade: Persistence and Decay of User Memories in Model Parameters
abstract: arXiv:2611.25235v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parametric memory allows Large Language Models to internalize knowledge directly into their weights, offering a potentially powerful alternative to retrieval-based memory (RAG). However, existing approaches to parametric memory are difficult to deploy as they largely mirror the Continual Learning (CL) objective of retaining information indefinitely. This is neither sustainable nor sufficient for a memory system, which must govern knowledge across its lifecycle by retaining stable facts, reinforcing recurring observations, updating changed beliefs, and allowing transient information to fade. We propose a system for parametric memory management consisting of a memory substrate (handling information storage and forgetting) and a learned policy (what to remember, how deeply, and for how long). translated_title: 有些记忆必须消逝：用户记忆在模型参数中的持久性与衰减
translated_abstract: 参数化记忆使大型语言模型能够将知识直接内化到权重中，为基于检索的记忆（RAG）提供了一种潜在强大的替代方案。然而，现有的参数化记忆方法难以部署，因为它们在很大程度上沿用了持续学习的目标，即无限期地保留信息。这对于记忆系统而言既不可持续也不充分，因为记忆系统必须管理知识的整个生命周期：保留稳定的事实、强化反复出现的观察、更新已经改变的信念，并允许短暂的信息逐渐消退。我们提出了一个参数化记忆管理系统，由记忆基底（负责信息的存储与遗忘）和学习策略（决定记住什么、以多深的程度记住、以及记住多久）组成。我们的基底是一个固定容量的LoRA适配器，由k-hot秩组合构成，能够在不产生灾难性干扰的情况下存储事实……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种参数化记忆管理系统，通过固定容量的LoRA适配器作为记忆基底，配合学习策略来管理知识的完整生命周期——保留稳定事实、强化重复观察、更新变化的信念，并让短暂信息自然消退。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a parametric memory management system that combines a fixed-capacity LoRA memory substrate with a learned policy to govern knowledge throughout its lifecycle—retaining stable facts, reinforcing recurring observations, updating changed beliefs, and letting transient information fade.
